description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport class, which implements a report endpoint related to employee leave entitlements and usage within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for defining report headers, filters, data retrieval, validation rules, and access control, leveraging various traits and dependencies to generate a report on employee leave balances and usage.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: This class provides the implementation for generating an employee leave entitlement and usage report, including defining headers, filters, data retrieval, validation, and access control mechanisms.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header layout including columns for leave type, entitlement, pending approval, scheduled, taken, and balance days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters such as employee number, date range, and report type from the request context.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters, including employee number and date constraints.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the user has permissions to access the report and if the leave period is defined, throwing exceptions if not.
